For normal phones: after locking, scan for up to 5 seconds. Landscape and a 30°–75° desk tilt must stay stable for 1.5 seconds. Moving or charging an unlocked phone never starts the clock.

Choose Linzin Desk Clock in the system screen-saver settings. On supported devices the system starts it while charging or docked; the same posture and charging checks apply. Exit with the top-right button or a long swipe up from the bottom edge.

One-time setup is required. When enabled, the event monitor survives closing the task and resumes after reboot. Only a new lock starts a bounded scan. Some manufacturers additionally require allowing background activity or auto-start in app settings. Force-stop always stops monitoring until you reopen the app. The clock never dismisses system security.

To open the clock after you lock from another app, Android requires the Display over other apps special access. This app uses that documented permission to open its normal clock activity only after a valid lock-triggered scan; it does not draw an overlay over your apps or unlock your phone. Enable it once in the next system page. You can turn this option off at any time.
